title: You deserve a travel power adapter you actually like for your next trip
summary: Get rid of those oversized all-in-one chunks of plastic.
body: When I was a writer for The Wirecutter more than a decade ago, we were obsessed with finding and recommending the singular best version of any specific product, because it felt like there was so much crap to wade through online. Today I wistfully long for the Amazon of 2013, before it came to be overrun by endless samey garbage from alphabet soup "brands" called things like HORUSDY and EHEYCIGA. If you're really looking for the cheapest thing you can get, you'll find those same products without the dropshipping markup on Aliexpress; and if you want the "best" thing, even seemingly personal recommendations on sites like Reddit are fraught as companies astroturf the site hoping to game AI search . So when I find a bit of kit that I really like that falls somewhere in the middle and is simply good , I feel like it's my duty to evangelize it a little bit. That's the case with the Ceptics Travel Adapter , which has accompanied me to China, Korea, the UK, and Brazil in the last few years. There are a gazillion power adapter options out there that'll get the job done, but this is the only one I've owned that I can say I really like for international travel, and that's because it's simple…
